infographic.title: Pressure Gauge Calibration Sequence
infographic.alt: Infographic of the pressure gauge calibration sequence: exercise the gauge, take readings going up, take readings coming down, then adjust and repeat
steps: Apply full scale for a minute, vent, wait a minute. Repeat 2 to 3 times.
Set the pointer exactly on the 25, 50, 75 and 100% marks and read the reference.
Check 75, 50 and 25% on the way down to find hysteresis.
Correct zero, span or linearity, then run all points again.
